app.title: give-me-real-gpu settings
app.subtitle: GPU cloud emulator settings
lang.label: Language
status.setup_body: The fake OpenStack API answers 503 until the advertise host and the OpenStack password are set.
status.register_help: Register these values in the management platform.
general.title: General
general.advertise_host_hint: Host name or IP the management platform uses to reach this emulator. It goes into the endpoint URLs of the keystone catalog.
general.secret_set_hint: A password is set. Leave the field empty to keep it.
general.secret_unset_hint: No password yet. The management platform logs in with this password.
general.token_ttl_hint: How long a keystone token stays valid, e.g. 1h or 30m.
general.interval_hint: How often metrics are written to every sink, e.g. 10s. At least 1s.
general.seed_hint: Random seed for the generated values. The same seed gives the same series.
general.seed_invalid: Seed must be a whole number.
general.xid_rate_hint: Chance per GPU per write that an XID error appears, from 0 to 1.
general.xid_rate_invalid: XID error rate must be a number.
general.dry_run_hint: Generate metrics but do not send them to any sink.
general.ports_note: The ports (-listen for the OpenStack API, -ui-listen for this page) are command-line flags. Changing them needs a restart.
general.saved: Saved. The new settings are in effect now.
sinks.title: Sinks
sinks.help: Every enabled sink receives the metrics on each write interval.
sinks.empty: No sinks yet. Add one to start writing metrics.
sinks.name: Name
sinks.url_hint_influxdb: Base URL of the InfluxDB v1 server, e.g. http://192.0.2.10:8086.
sinks.url_changed_warning: Changing the URL clears the saved password and token. Enter them again.
sinks.basic_auth_hint: Basic authentication. Leave both empty for none.
sinks.credential_id_hint: UUID written as the credential_id tag. Required when the sink is enabled.
sinks.delete_confirm: Delete the sink {name}? Metrics stop going there.
